[EN] Thulsa's always used cowardly tactics. His successes are hollow because he doesn't earn his victories.

Kaia, on the other hand, always fights with valor and honor.
[ES] Thulsa siempre ha usado tácticas cobardes. Sus éxitos están vacíos porque no se gana sus victorias.

Kaia, en cambio, siempre lucha con valor y honor.
